scope:
Capture one owned nano's intrinsic credentials without exporting secret material.

Two single-AZ private STS/SQS endpoints and one owned queue exercise an explicit
resource grant with an attached-profile positive control. No public networking,
standing resources or account defaults are changed. Estimated total below $0.10;
900-second experiment plus bounded independently checked cleanup.

#!/bin/bash
set -eu
umask 077
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /root/stackd-identity-probe.py
cat > /etc/systemd/system/stackd-identity-probe.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/stackd-identity-probe.py
TimeoutStartSec=500
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now stackd-identity-probe.service
